intent_en: To illustrate the elemental composition of a celestial body, demonstrating that it is predominantly made of hydrogen and helium.
previous_intent: To illustrate the elemental composition of the Sun, highlighting that it is primarily made of hydrogen and helium with only trace amounts of heavier elements.
narration_support: For the most part, it consists of hydrogen and helium.
chart_support: Pie chart displaying a large majority for Hydrogen (H) and a smaller portion for Helium (He), representing the primary components.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly states the composition is mostly hydrogen and helium, while the chart visualizes this with a large 'H' section and a smaller 'He' section. The narration mentions heavy elements (<2%), which corresponds to the tiny sliver in the chart, though the chart labels only H and He.
